summary: EyeGuard iteration 2 (Pro subscription + owner-controlled paid mode). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed (all Pro/Admin/Checkout + regression Settings/PIN/Stats). Frontend: verified hidden admin entry (5-tap on Settings title), admin unlock with 142536, paid-mode toggle switches state, /pro/status reflects change instantly, pro-upsell card appears on Settings when paid mode ON & not pro, Stats tab shows stats-lock overlay + stats-unlock-btn navigates to /paywall, paywall renders plan-yearly/plan-monthly with correct prices ($14.99/$1.99), subscribe-btn creates a real Stripe checkout session (opened in new tab to checkout.stripe.com) and shows 'Verifying payment…' status polling, Child Mode toggle when paid mode ON & not pro correctly redirects to /paywall instead of enabling. Client-supplied amount is ignored server-side (Pydantic strips extras). Wrong admin code returns 403 for both /admin/config and /admin/paid-mode. Unknown checkout session returns 404. Paid mode reset to OFF at end so default UX is free.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a third-party component (BlurView / LinearGradient / expo-router). Non-blocking but should be tracked. Reference: browser console during app load.

action_items: Nothing critical. Optional: investigate source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning; likely originating from a library, migrate when upstream fix is available.
Optional hardening: reject unknown fields in CheckoutBody with extra='forbid' if you want stricter API surface (currently amount is silently ignored, which is safe but permissive).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /admin/config uses query-string code — acceptable but consider POST/body for admin secrets to avoid URL logging.
get_active_pass sorts by paid_at desc but transactions may have paid_at=None for pending; the status:'paid' filter guards this correctly.
checkout/status uses external Stripe call each poll — fine for now, cached once paid.
seed_data_creation: None. Two Stripe test checkout sessions were created during testing (status=pending/created); paid_mode was reset to OFF at completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin code=142536, admin toggle stored in db.pro_config. Payments in db.payment_transactions. Paid mode default OFF -> is_pro=true universally. To test locked UI, first PUT /api/admin/paid-mode {code, enabled:true}, then reset to false. Stripe checkout completion cannot be automated end-to-end; verify only session creation + status polling.
